description: This file defines a Lookup class for searching and highlighting notes, tags, notebooks, reminders, trash items, and attachments within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for fuzzy search, regex search, highlighting query matches in HTML content, and rebuilding search indexes.

classes.name: Lookup
classes.description: A class providing search and highlight functionalities for notes, tags, notebooks, reminders, trash items, and attachments within the Notesnook application.

methods.name: notes
methods.description: Performs a fuzzy and regex search for notes matching the query, returning their IDs.

methods.name: notesWithHighlighting
methods.description: Performs a search for notes and returns highlighted results with content and title matches.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds the search index for the database.
